assertion.statement: The Crossplane 2.0.0 release notes list an addition (PR #6372) of an env annotation to render docker runtime containers, but the note does not state the annotation's name, where it is set, or any operational effect.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The only evidence is the PR title line; it does not name the annotation, the manifest/resource or field it is set on, or the component that reads it, so no subject family identity can be pinned.; applicability: The evidence names no annotation key, resource kind, or usage condition that a predicate could read, and it does not state which environments are affected by the addition.; consequence: The release note only states that the env annotation was added; it does not say what happens (or does not happen) in environments whether or not they use it.
